runs.name: Pure Cycle Corporation; Nasdaq PCYO, SEC CIK 0000276720, fiscal year to August 31; wholesale water and wastewater services in the Denver area under exclusive contracts (Rangeview District, Lowry Ranch to 2081, Sky Ranch), development of the Sky Ranch master planned community on the I-70 corridor, and single-family homes for rent; cooperation agreement with Maran Capital (14.7%) 2026-01-14, the Maran directors resigned May and July 2026, Maran nominated five directors for 2027; the FY2026 10-K not yet filed; the 10-K names only the City of Aurora, not an SEC filer
runs.box: OUT AT Q2 (ordinary returns in the deciding part, land development; computation only beneath the stop)
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence and competitors derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7. Price **$10.65** (close 2026-10-28, aggregator, flagged) x **24,097,370 shares** (10-Q cover for the quarter to 2026-05-31, accession 0001104659-26-081778; the balance sheet the same; 432,513 Series B preferred, immaterial) = cap **$256.6M**; sovereign **5.37%** (US Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-28). Filings: 10-K FY2025 0001104659-25-110312, the 10-Q above, DEF 14A 0001104659-25-118311, 8-Ks of 2026, DEFA14A 0001104659-26-092839. **Q1 IN**: three businesses plainly described; judged not a regulated utility for Q7, rates capped by contract at the average of three nearby providers and set by the Rangeview District, whose board is mostly company officers and employees, with no allowed return. **Q2 OUT**: land development is 62% of five-year segment profit and decides; the 10-K calls it "a highly competitive business"; the edge (owned water, land bought cheaply in 2010) passes to homebuilders as lower lot prices and is used up as Sky Ranch sells out, eight to ten years left by the filer's estimate; the water part alone earns about 8% before corporate costs, so the box is the same whichever part decides. Comparison set chosen as a CONVENTION of the run (the 10-K names no rival that files), net income over average equity 2014 to 2025: PCYO 4.1% (8.9% in its profitable years since FY2018), Forestar 7.9%, Five Point 1.1%, St. Joe 12.8% (8.4% from 2015). Q3 to Q12 NOT REACHED. Balance sheet over ten year-ends: no goodwill; equity $69.0M to $151.6M, almost all retained; related-district notes $59.1M, a third of assets, repayable only from district taxes, fees or bonds and discharged if unpaid by 2058 and 2060; nine months to 2026-05-31 cash $21.9M to $8.4M and debt doubled to $14.1M; FY2021 income included a one-time $20.2M recognition of earlier-expensed public-improvement costs. Facts after the stop, recorded not judged: company officers a majority of the boards of the largest customer and of the notes' debtor, the company judging the notes' collectability; pay judged partly on EBITDA and an adjusted return on equity; buyback with no stated price, last purchases at $10.65; no dividend. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: tools/run.py took one of four filed capital-spending lines and was replaced from the filed cash-flow statements; owner cash FY2021 to FY2025 average -$0.33M a year after all spending, $4.29M after maintenance (depreciation as the guess), falling 13.4% a year between the halves of the window; value range all-equity, central, **$0.10 to $3.20 a share**, equity-only $0.29 to $3.32; fair price all-equity $0.71, equity-only $0.90; no case earns about ten percent at the price. Could not get: the FY2026 10-K, per-lot prices, the 2010 cost of Sky Ranch, the rivals' statements read directly (their figures from tagged data). Framework gaps for the operator: the business of parts when the land part exists to sell the water part's taps; a liquidating parcel under Q2's ten to twenty years and Q7's carry forward; specific (e) when the shown growth is negative; a related-party loan book inside operating cash; the template trusting tools/run.py's single capex line. Write-early not kept: Step 0 to the facts after the stop written and committed in one pass, declared by the analyst. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, all 33 ids in the ledger, 15 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, none flagged; no tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: another company's commit subjects, another research folder in the git status, a memory index line; none names PCYO, none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2: land development at Sky Ranch decides, a finite parcel in a highly competitive field whose edge passes to the homebuilders and is used up as the lots sell; returns ordinary against Forestar, Five Point and St. Joe, the water part alone about 8%; officers sit on the boards of the largest customer and of the debtor on a third of the assets; computation only, all-equity value range $0.10 to $3.20 against $10.65. Not armed.
